title: AI & Automation Engineer
description: Job Title: AI & Automation EngineerLocation: Eccles, ManchesterSalary: CompetitiveJob Type: Full Time, PermanentNetteam tX is looking for a hands-on engineer to take ownership of our existing Rewst automations, improve their reliability and expand our automation and AI capability across internal operations and customer services.You will inherit live automation assets, stabilise and document them, then build secure workflows, integrations and AI agents that reduce manual effort, improve consistency and create repeatable value.This is an engineering and ownership role, not a service desk position with occasional automation duties. automation and dependency register.Workflow and integration engineering:Design, build, test and maintain event-driven and scheduled workflows using the platform best suited to the requirement.Develop resilient PowerShell and API integrations with secure authentication, pagination, rate-limit awareness, structured logging, exception handling and rollback.AI agents and intelligent workflows:Deliver practical agents and AI-enabled workflows that use approved knowledge, request approval where needed, record evidence and escalate safely when confidence is insufficient.Design prompts, instructions, tools, actions, grounding sources and evaluation scenarios that produce repeatable, measurable outputs.Security, governance and production reliability:Apply least privilege, environment separation, approved identities, secure secrets, audit logging, change control, monitoring and safe fallbacks.Treat prompt injection, excessive permissions, unsafe actions, sensitive-data exposure, ungrounded acceptance criteria, and support estimates, demonstrations, proposals and Statements of Work.Create runbooks, architecture notes, data-flow diagrams, test evidence and user guidance, and train teams to use solutions and recognise failure conditions.Technology environment :The role spans Rewst, PowerShell, REST APIs, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure, Intune, Datto RMM, GetThread, Windows and Active Directory, n8n, Power Automate, Make, Copilot Studio, Claude, ChatGPT and Codex. You are not expected to know every platform on day one, but you must be able to choose tools thoughtfully and learn quickly.About you:Skills & Experience:Essential:Experience in automation engineering within an MSP or enterprise environment.Strong PowerShell scripting and automation development skills.Experience with:Microsoft 365AzureIntunePower PlatformRMM and PSA platformsExperience building API integrations and workflow automations.Knowledge of AI platforms and automation technologies.Strong understanding of IT service management processes.Experience implementing governance and change control processes.Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.Desirable:Microsoft Copilot implementation experience.Azure AI Services experience.OpenAI integration experience.Power Automate advanced development.Logic Apps development.Data analytics and reporting experience.Experience delivering customer-facing consulting engagements.AI governance or responsible AI framework experience.Diversity and Inclusion:We are proactively committed to creating a diverse workforce at Netteam tX.
